reddit.title: Exciting Updates: Ten Locales and Improved Placement in Provincia
reddit.body: We're thrilled to announce some major improvements in our latest update for Provincia! Our build UI now supports ten languages, making it more accessible to players around the world. We've also enhanced placement feedback to help you understand why certain placements fail, and we've streamlined day/night transitions to ensure a smoother gameplay experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
